**Loomly gets $18,400 and Pinecrest Rentals gets $6,200**—100% of their November platform fees, applied as credits on their December invoices, not cash. The Nov. 13 approval replaced the earlier 50% proposal [5].

**November books: planned, but I couldn’t verify it was posted.** Marcus confirmed the $24,600 will be accrued in November as a reduction of revenue, with Jenna posting the journal entry. The close checklist still shows it as “In progress,” and I found no posting confirmation when I searched for the journal entry [2][1].

Loomly’s separate **$7,690 overdraft reimbursement request** is still undecided and excluded from the November accrual for now. Loomly was promised an answer by Nov. 25 [2][3].
